Adventist World Radio FAQ

What frequency is Adventist World Radio on?
In the B-26 season Adventist World Radio is scheduled on 32 shortwave frequencies, including 6065, 7375, 9610, 9720, 9760, 9800 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 6065 kHz (10 pm – 11 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9760 kHz (7 pm – 8 pm UTC+1).

What time is Adventist World Radio on shortwave?
Adventist World Radio is scheduled in 35 UTC time windows this season, from 00:00–00:30 UTC through 23:00–24h UTC. No English broadcasts are listed this season. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear Adventist World Radio in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 6065 kHz (10 pm – 11 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Adventist World Radio broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. Adventist World Radio is scheduled in MSY, Korean, Amoy, Cantonese, Mandarin.

Is Adventist World Radio on the air right now?
As of Saturday, November 7, 2026, 11:43 UTC, Adventist World Radio is scheduled to be broadcasting on 15270 kHz to Far East. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
